test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_join_filter_fusion (id UInt64, arr Array(String), payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_join_filter_fusion SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> concat('e', toString(x % 20)), range(number % 40)), repeat('x', 256) FROM numbers(3000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(cityHash64(elem, payload)) FROM array_join_filter_fusion ARRAY JOIN arr AS elem WHERE elem = 'e7'
SELECT count() FROM array_join_filter_fusion ARRAY JOIN arr AS elem WHERE elem = 'e7' AND NOT ignore(payload)
SELECT sum(cityHash64(elem, payload)) FROM array_join_filter_fusion ARRAY JOIN arr AS elem WHERE elem < 'e5'
SELECT sum(cityHash64(elem, payload)) FROM array_join_filter_fusion ARRAY JOIN arr AS elem WHERE elem = 'e7' SETTINGS query_plan_fuse_filter_into_array_join = 0
